basics.name: Surya Prakash Rao Kapila
basics.label: Backend Software Engineer | Distributed Systems | AI-Native Development
basics.summary: Backend engineer with 5+ years of professional experience: 3 years building and running production backend systems, plus 2.5 years in test and validation engineering. Currently the technical owner of a platform serving 40+ enterprise clients at over 100,000 requests per day, built on C#/.NET and SQL Server with Node.js and TypeScript services alongside. Builds AI natively: ships daily on Claude Code, stood up a RAG index over a production codebase, and writes Gen AI systems from scratch. Goes deep, stays curious, and keeps the backend ahead of where AI is heading.

work.name: Cadient Talent
highlights: Primary technical owner of a backend platform serving 40+ enterprise clients at over 100,000 requests per day, covering production support, architecture and delivery after the team lead's departure.

Built a multi-tenant Node.js and TypeScript service for Job, Employee and Location synchronisation: REST APIs on TypeScript, Zod, SQL Server and TypeORM, with retry and reconciliation so partial failures never corrupt client data.

Built internal engineering tooling on Claude Code plus a RAG index over the codebase, cutting the time to trace a defect through unfamiliar code and shortening onboarding for new joiners. AI applied as production engineering, not a demo.

Write unit tests for C# services with MSTest, using AI to generate first-pass coverage and reviewing every case before merge; hold AI-generated changes to the same review bar as hand-written code, through pull requests, peer review and CI/CD.

Design and run a C# service layer of WCF/ASMX SOAP services and REST endpoints over SQL Server, owning correctness at the boundary: validating payloads in both directions and absorbing upstream changes without client-facing downtime.

Delivered 11 partner integrations end to end in 14 months, from requirements through interface design, C# implementation and production rollout, across job distribution, HRIS and background-screening partners (ZipRecruiter, AppCast, UKG Pro, AccuSource, QJumpers, and internal Job/Location/User APIs).

Resolve customer-reported production issues end to end, tracing failures across the C# layer, SQL Server and third-party APIs, and communicating root cause and remediation directly to enterprise clients.

work.name: CoSchool
highlights: Built production REST APIs and backend services in Node.js, NestJS and TypeScript on an Agile team, applying object-oriented design and established service patterns.
Designed an event-driven notification platform on Kafka, decoupling distributed services through asynchronous messaging instead of synchronous calls.
Cut database load 35% with Redis caching on hot read paths, and improved backend response times roughly 20% through query optimisation and service refactoring.
Deployed and validated services with Docker; used AWS CloudWatch for observability across logs and metrics, monitoring application health and triaging production and pre-production issues.
Wrote Python scripts, schedulers and automated workflows to handle recurring backend and operational tasks without manual intervention.

Expanded automated regression coverage with Jest and Cucumber; covered frontend delivery in React and Redux for six months during a resource shortfall; mentored junior engineers through code review and backend design sessions.

work.name: Career Break
work.position: Full-time preparation for the Indian Civil Services (UPSC) examination

work.name: Robert Bosch GmbH (via Hays)
highlights: Validated automotive RADAR systems in C++ with the Vector toolchain in a safety-critical environment, working to formal test specifications and defect-tracking discipline.

work.name: Cint Consulting
highlights: Performed hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) testing of photovoltaic inverter systems in C++ using MATLAB/Simulink models and the Vector toolchain, validating controller behaviour against simulated grid and array conditions and automating regression test cases against formal test specifications.

projects.name: RAG-Search-Engine
projects.description: A retrieval stack built from scratch (sparse ranking, dense retrieval, and their fusion) as the foundation for a full RAG system. Written to understand the tradeoffs rather than to wrap a library.

projects.name: Coding Agent
projects.description: Autonomous coding agent with tool orchestration, multi-step reasoning and a validation layer that checks generated code before it is applied. Built as modular components so additional tools and model providers can be added.

projects.name: AI Investment Pipeline
projects.description: Three-stage pipeline that sources startups, scores them against a versioned investment thesis and generates evidence-backed memos, using structured outputs with caching and run-level observability.

projects.name: RabbitMQ Pub/Sub Service
projects.description: Message-driven publish/subscribe service on RabbitMQ with typed message contracts and consumer workflows that scale horizontally.
